decision_rule: Adopt the cheapest arm that matches the incumbent's accuracy, returns valid JSON 100% of the time, and does not require granting training rights. Ties go to the incumbent.
note_on_parse_failures: analyst_agent._parse_eval_response defaults to verdict='fail' on a parse error, and 2 of 3 graded cases expect 'fail'. JSON validity is checked independently here; unparseable responses are excluded from accuracy and counted as compliance failures.
